title: Malta foundation with a solar power station and planned GPU data center

plain: A research foundation is being set up on the island of Malta, with a rented site, a solar power station already installed, and plans for a data center full of GPUs, the powerful chips used for heavy computing. Filippo Biondi, a researcher who claims to have found huge structures beneath the pyramids of Egypt, describes it as his own project in the 2020s: "We have rented a nice place where we have installed it a solar power station." It is meant to give his work its own computing power.
